notes.title: Tiny Teams! Demo update
notes.notes:
Tiny Teams is here!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892249/40b156a8866fdfc78eaed9ce7caff257ccf660a0.png

I'm so grateful to be part of this year's Tiny Teams celebration! This festival showcases beautiful, interesting, and unique games created by solo devs and small groups. Its a great opportunity to discover a handful of games you've never heard of. Please check out all these great games here - Tiny Teams on Steam 

Pinball Blitz has gotten quite the face lift in anticipation for this festival.. 

 The Pinball Wizard is now expecting you after each level-up, excited to grant you a potion to help you succeed.
 The first boss makes its appearance on level 6..
 A run now ends with a final blitz - a stand against the table as enemies speed up and points fly.
 A new theme: "POTION"


As always, if you ever run into an issue or have a bright, new suggestion, don't hesitate to reach out! I would love to hear your input - Discord
